prohibited_claims: Endpoint 1 is the true or globally minimal sufficient circuit size.
Endpoint 2 is the true number of distinct circuits.
Raw packing counts across discovery methods are perfectly resource-matched.
Student initializations are independent population-level replicates.
Hard-target and soft-target students may be pooled.
Fourier interchange establishes a unique algorithm or mechanism.
Stage 2 makes the full protocol numerically final.

frozen_items.claim_limit: Freezes the scientific question only; it does not freeze later numeric, roster, or production choices.
frozen_items.name: Exact research question
frozen_items.normative_statement: > Under a fixed component basis, intervention and evaluation protocol, does the grokking-associated change in sparse-circuit recoverability follow the teacher function, vary across distilled realizations of that function, or arise from the distillation and discovery procedures themselves?

frozen_items.claim_limit: No lower level may be treated as the population-level unit.
frozen_items.name: Experimental hierarchy
frozen_items.normative_statement: The hierarchy is teacher seed -> phase within teacher -> distillation condition -> student initialization -> discovery method -> thresholds/circuits, with phase repeated within teacher.

frozen_items.claim_limit: Student initializations are not independent population replicates.
frozen_items.name: Population-level unit
frozen_items.normative_statement: Teacher seed is the population-level unit.

frozen_items.claim_limit: It measures conditional realization variation rather than population-level replication.
frozen_items.name: Student-initialization interpretation
frozen_items.normative_statement: Student initialization is realization variation conditional on a teacher.

frozen_items.claim_limit: They are not independent population units.
frozen_items.name: Repeated-measurement layers
frozen_items.normative_statement: Methods, thresholds, and circuits are repeated measurements within the higher-level hierarchy.

frozen_items.claim_limit: Pooling hard and soft students into one estimand is prohibited.
frozen_items.name: Hard and soft estimands
frozen_items.normative_statement: Hard-target and soft-target students are separate estimands and are never pooled.

frozen_items.claim_limit: Teacher circuit behavior may not be inferred only through distilled students.
frozen_items.name: Direct teacher evaluation
frozen_items.normative_statement: Every selected teacher is evaluated directly under the identical circuit protocol.

frozen_items.claim_limit: Any hard-target student failing even one teacher argmax decision is ineligible.
frozen_items.name: Hard-target eligibility
frozen_items.normative_statement: Hard-target eligibility requires 100% reproduction of teacher argmax decisions over all 12,769 inputs.

frozen_items.claim_limit: It is not defined relative to the teacher's dense outputs.
frozen_items.name: Student circuit-fidelity reference
frozen_items.normative_statement: Student circuit fidelity is relative to the student's own dense outputs.

frozen_items.claim_limit: Implementation details, threshold, and precision remain unresolved until Stage 12.
frozen_items.name: Proposed primary fidelity family
frozen_items.normative_statement: Centred-logit predictive fidelity is the proposed primary fidelity family, including per-input additive-logit gauge removal.

frozen_items.claim_limit: The fallback keeps Endpoint 1 defined when sparse recovery fails.
frozen_items.name: Endpoint 1 definition
frozen_items.normative_statement: Endpoint 1 is the smallest recovered qualifying component proportion under a specified procedure, with the intact mask at proportion 1.0 as fallback.

frozen_items.claim_limit: It must not be described as the true or globally minimal sufficient circuit size.
frozen_items.name: Endpoint 1 interpretation limit
frozen_items.normative_statement: Endpoint 1 is procedure-relative and only an upper bound on the unknown globally minimal sufficient proportion.

frozen_items.claim_limit: It must not be described as the true number of distinct circuits or an exhaustive circuit count.
frozen_items.name: Endpoint 2 definition and interpretation
frozen_items.normative_statement: Endpoint 2 is a procedure-relative packing lower bound under a specified procedure, including zero when no qualifying circuit is recovered.

frozen_items.claim_limit: Raw packing counts across methods are not described as perfectly resource-matched.
frozen_items.name: Method-budget interpretation
frozen_items.normative_statement: Discovery methods receive method-specific native budgets plus a common final exact-mask-evaluation allowance, and primary phase/student comparisons are interpreted within method.

frozen_items.claim_limit: The protocol does not prospectively predict which category will occur.
frozen_items.name: Outcome-category status
frozen_items.normative_statement: The six stated outcome categories are interpretations, not predictions.

frozen_items.claim_limit: It is not a primary endpoint and does not establish uniqueness.
frozen_items.name: Fourier interchange scope
frozen_items.normative_statement: Fourier interchange is a gated secondary experiment with all five required controls.

frozen_items.claim_limit: They cannot silently become required primary analyses.
frozen_items.name: Gated extensions
frozen_items.normative_statement: Entropy estimation, cross-task breadth, general theory, and conditional atlases are gated extensions outside the core critical path.

frozen_items.claim_limit: Such output may not select phase checkpoints, thresholds, component caps, overlap cutoffs, student counts, methods, budgets, or other scientific protocol values.
frozen_items.name: Method-development firewall
frozen_items.normative_statement: Pre-freeze endpoint-producing method-development output must be excluded, registered, and regenerated after freeze before definitive use.
